name: v1.14.6
body:
## [Talos 1.14.6](https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/releases/tag/v1.14.6) (2026-11-11) Welcome to the v1.14.6 release of Talos! Please try out the release binaries and report any issues at https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/issues. ### Component Updates Linux: 6.18.63 Flannel CNI: 0.28.10 Talos is built with Go 1.26.11. ### Contributors * Andrey Smirnov * Fábio Matavelli * Jake Watson * Justin Garrison * Mateusz Urbanek * Matthew Kelch * Max Makarov * Noel * Raphaël DUCOM * Scott Vandiver * frauniki * saguila * zavermax ### Changes
20 commits

* siderolabs/talos@ede45c42d release(v1.14.6): prepare release * siderolabs/talos@b42de4573 fix: update GoBGP library to 4.10.0 * siderolabs/talos@008f6c3de fix: bump Go version in constants * siderolabs/talos@52417038c chore: rekres * siderolabs/talos@2b98b3991 fix: update Go dependencies * siderolabs/talos@ba1ae32da fix: wait for control plane static pods during Kubernetes CA rotation * siderolabs/talos@a16555ed5 fix: log lifecycle service actions to console * siderolabs/talos@8f6c141db fix: don't zero the discovered volume partition offset * siderolabs/talos@421d1589d fix: give the mdadm runtime map directory a dedicated SELinux type * siderolabs/talos@c106f41fe fix: mask the SideroLink join token * siderolabs/talos@a02b84749 fix: drop architecture constraints from affinity rules * siderolabs/talos@93b0e406f feat: update pkgs & tools * siderolabs/talos@cc384acab fix: use aescbc provider for AES-CBC key in etcd encryption config * siderolabs/talos@bfc139c8f fix: skip logical links when matching OpenStack interfaces by MAC * siderolabs/talos@e28686aa9 fix: open the files of pkg/xfs roots with O_CLOEXEC * siderolabs/talos@90bbad2f1 feat: update changed BGP peers * siderolabs/talos@8a3d3d4b3 fix: reconnect log senders when the receiver closes the connection * siderolabs/talos@e7bcb14fe feat: update Flannel to 0.28.10 * siderolabs/talos@c31b89093 feat: include applesmc module * siderolabs/talos@e867b1aba feat: update Go 1.26.11, Linux 6.18.63

### Changes from siderolabs/pkgs
11 commits

* siderolabs/pkgs@e6ad19d feat: update Linux to 6.18.63 * siderolabs/pkgs@28f56b5 feat: enable AMD Pensando ionic and ionic_rdma * siderolabs/pkgs@64ec876 fix: enable BROADCOM PHY on amd64 * siderolabs/pkgs@52e7730 feat: enable arm64 SMMUv3 SVA for ATS (NVIDIA Grace Hopper) * siderolabs/pkgs@5645412 feat: update dependencies * siderolabs/pkgs@5255939 feat: enable CONFIG_DRM_ACCEL_AMDXDNA on amd64 * siderolabs/pkgs@0190570 feat: update NVIDIA drivers * siderolabs/pkgs@ef77f92 feat: update backportable dependencies * siderolabs/pkgs@6c2142e feat: enable arm64 ff-a tpm crb support * siderolabs/pkgs@e06cc60 feat: enable applesmc on amd64 * siderolabs/pkgs@f26bb1b feat: update Go to 1.26.11

### Changes from siderolabs/tools
1 commit

* siderolabs/tools@5959f76 feat: update Go to 1.26.11

### Dependency Changes * **github.com/gopacket/gopacket** v1.7.1 -> v1.7.2 * **github.com/klauspost/compress** v1.19.2 -> v1.20.2 * **github.com/osrg/gobgp/v4** v4.8.0 -> v4.10.0 * **github.com/siderolabs/pkgs** v1.14.0-48-gf4bda77 -> v1.14.0-59-ge6ad19d * **github.com/siderolabs/talos/pkg/machinery** v1.14.5 -> v1.14.6 * **github.com/siderolabs/tools** v1.14.0-11-g8dad45e -> v1.14.0-12-g5959f76 * **golang.org/x/net** v0.61.0 -> v0.62.0 Previous release can be found at [v1.14.5](https://github.com/siderolabs/talos/releases/tag/v1.14.5) ## Images ``` ghcr.io/siderolabs/flannel:v0.28.10 registry.k8s.io/coredns/coredns:v1.14.7 registry.k8s.io/etcd:v3.7.3 registry.k8s.io/pause:3.10.2 registry.k8s.io/kube-apiserver:v1.37.1 registry.k8s.io/kube-controller-manager:v1.37.1 registry.k8s.io/kube-scheduler:v1.37.1 registry.k8s.io/kube-proxy:v1.37.1 ghcr.io/siderolabs/kubelet:v1.37.1 registry.k8s.io/networking/kube-network-policies:v1.1.2 ghcr.io/siderolabs/installer-base:v1.14.6 ghcr.io/siderolabs/imager:v1.14.6 ghcr.io/siderolabs/talos:v1.14.6 ghcr.io/siderolabs/talosctl-all:v1.14.6 ghcr.io/siderolabs/overlays:v1.14.6 ghcr.io/siderolabs/extensions:v1.14.6 ```
